results.content: Definition of *generate verb* from the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary. # generate. | he / she / it generates | /ˈdʒenəreɪts/  /ˈdʒenəreɪts/ |. 1. generate something to produce energy, especially electricity. * Living cells generate energy from food. 2. generate something to produce or create something. * We need someone to generate new ideas. Synonyms makemakedo ▪ create ▪ develop ▪ produce ▪ generate ▪ formThese words all mean to make something from parts or materials, or to cause something to exist or happen.make to create or prepare something by combining materials or putting parts together; to cause something to exist or happen:. create to make something exist or happen, especially something new that did not exist before:. * Brainstorming is a good way of generating ideas.form [often passive] to make something from something else; to make something into something else:.
